projects.name: SLO-Aware Agent Serving
projects.summary_en: Admission, calibrated prediction, fairness, and resource allocation for mixed agent workloads.
projects.summary_zh: 面向混合智能体负载的准入、校准预测、公平性与资源分配。

projects.name: VAMOS
projects.summary_en: VRAM-aware multi-model orchestration under serving SLOs.
projects.summary_zh: 面向服务 SLO 的显存感知多模型编排。

projects.name: Token-Budget Governor
projects.summary_en: Token-budget admission and overload control before work enters the inference engine.
projects.summary_zh: 在请求进入推理引擎前执行 token 预算准入与过载控制。

projects.name: Agent State Tiering
projects.summary_en: Workflow-aware placement and prefetch across accelerator, host-memory, and storage tiers.
projects.summary_zh: 跨加速器、主机内存与存储层的工作流感知放置和预取。

projects.name: Prefix Cache Routing Reliability
projects.summary_en: Failure-safe distributed prefix-cache routing, stale-view handling, and bounded recovery.
projects.summary_zh: 故障安全的分布式前缀缓存路由、陈旧视图处理与有界恢复。

projects.name: FreshKV
projects.summary_en: Owns agent-aware future-reuse signals, value calibration, physical KV mapping, retention and eviction decisions, and auditable execution receipts.
projects.summary_zh: 统一负责 Agent 感知的未来复用信号、价值校准、物理 KV 映射、保留与淘汰决策，以及可审计的执行回执。

projects.name: Quality-Bounded Inference
projects.summary_en: Maps task-level quality targets to token budgets, decode policies, and service controls.
projects.summary_zh: 把任务级质量目标映射为 token 预算、解码策略与服务控制动作。

projects.name: Workflow-Aware Serving
projects.summary_en: Uses DAG readiness, critical paths, tool waits, and deadlines to coordinate serving decisions.
projects.summary_zh: 依据 DAG 就绪状态、关键路径、工具等待与截止时间协调服务决策。

projects.name: MottoServe
projects.summary_en: Evidence and analysis of serving-policy behavior, planner overhead, and applicability boundaries.
projects.summary_zh: 研究服务策略行为、规划器开销与适用边界的证据分析课题。
